plans.goal: Shield Maud from attacks while You and Borin intercept the brute and skirmisher
steps: Position between Maud and the approaching foes
Have Borin block Fitch on the flank
Keep Maud protected to heal wounded

atoms.text: Move between Col Garrow and Sister Maud to block his advance.
Borin, block Fitch so he can't get to Maud.
Challenge Col Garrow to face you instead.

plans.goal: Use terrain to create a defensive line and prevent enemies from surrounding the group
steps: Create barriers between Maud and attackers
Use shove to control enemy positions

atoms.text: Take cover behind the cart to shield from Nell's arrows.
Stand at the crate between You and Fitch, don't let him past.
If Fitch gets close, shove him into the fallen log to slow him down.
Guard Pip while Borin guards the approach from Col.

plans.goal: Prepare to rescue and swap places with any wounded companion to keep them from the front
steps: Stay mobile to reach hurt allies
Offer protection to anyone taking damage

atoms.text: Stay ready to grab any companion who gets hit.
If Borin takes a hard hit, swap places with him so you absorb the next attack.
If Pip gets badly wounded, carry Pip to safety behind Maud.
Step in front of Sister Maud whenever Col or Fitch get close.
